description: When the wrapper reports no interpreter, a .py hook has no launcher: it is logged and skipped, and a .sh hook after it still runs.

expect.log:
[ pfB Hook ] pre #0 script 'hook_pre_a.py' has no usable launcher; skipping

[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 (hook_pre_b.sh, timeout 60s)
[ pfB Hook ] pre #1 completed
